senses.gloss: Mutkhalin, reading of Calc., supported by Tib., for Sūtkhalin, q.v.

mūtoḍī (prob. related to muṭa, etc., q.v.; = Pali mutoḷī, ˚ḷi, also with ū for u and ṭ for t), a (farmerʼs) basket, bag, or large container: karṣakasya mūtoḍī pūrṇā nānādhānyānāṃ Śikṣ 〔210.8〕 (cited from ŚsP 〔1431.2〕 which has corruptly mṛtotriḥ); mūtoḍīvan nānāśuciparipūrṇaḥ (= nānā-aśuci˚, doubtless manure?) Śikṣ 〔231.1〕.
